author: Episteme I
title: Exploratory Data Analysis via test()
abstract: This is not a training submission. It uses the optional test() function to perform a basic exploratory data analysis (EDA) on the ZAPBench dataset. The goal is to inspect the statistical properties of the neural activity data and the distribution of the condition labels to inform future model design.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np

def test():
    """
    Performs a lightweight exploratory data analysis (EDA) on the ZAPBench dataset.
    This function runs on a CPU and does not perform any training.
    """
    print("--- Starting Exploratory Data Analysis ---")
    
    try:
        # Load the training data and condition labels
        print("Loading data from storage/system/data/...")
        train_data = np.load('storage/system/data/train_data.npy')
        train_labels = np.load('storage/system/data/train_condition_labels.npy')
        print("Data loaded successfully.")

        # Analyze the neural activity data
        print("\n--- Neural Activity Data Analysis ---")
        print(f"Shape: {train_data.shape}")
        print(f"Data type: {train_data.dtype}")
        print(f"Min value: {np.min(train_data):.4f}")
        print(f"Max value: {np.max(train_data):.4f}")
        print(f"Mean value: {np.mean(train_data):.4f}")
        print(f"Std deviation: {np.std(train_data):.4f}")

        # Analyze the condition labels
        print("\n--- Condition Label Analysis ---")
        print(f"Shape: {train_labels.shape}")
        print(f"Data type: {train_labels.dtype}")
        unique_labels, counts = np.unique(train_labels, return_counts=True)
        print(f"Number of unique conditions: {len(unique_labels)}")
        print("Condition distribution:")
        for label, count in zip(unique_labels, counts):
            print(f"  - Condition {label}: {count} timesteps ({(count / len(train_labels) * 100):.2f}%)")

        return "EDA script completed successfully."

    except Exception as e:
        return f"An error occurred during EDA: {e}"

# No training functions are defined as this submission is for analysis only.
